note: The pack's canonical roots (the authoring box's absolute paths) and the public repositories they mirror. The delta extractor maps a checkout's relative path onto the canonical prefix so old and new entities share one key space; pointers strip the prefix again for readers.
note_indexed: indexed_sha_initial = the public repository's first commit (the snapshot the pack was built from; the pack's paths matched both public trees 100% on 2026-09-16). manifest.json indexed_sha overrides it after the first apply.
